Dream 2026-11-22 linked 5 vignettes from 3 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-25 · touches · "Domains can refine, they can also overlap. They can also overlap on different dimensions." (Several models of the flow; domains refine or overlap, here they refine (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "These synthetic maps never need to be absolute. They are always relative to a domain." (Base trigram axes and poles apply by default; every decision gets a trigram, and consistency builds the system (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "our base poles and these get carried through all domains. They just get refined and renamed" (Evolve shared understanding gradually; the three lines are a universal lens every domain carries (2026-10-28))
- 2026-11-06 · retells · "any domain inherits the base axes." (Any domain inherits the base axes as working defaults (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · retells · "may clone the domain, and then only break some parts off. Lots may be shared. But not all." (A way of working is emerging: shared semantic infrastructure under domains and essays, comparing parents, siblings and children, cloning a domain, and zoomability (2026-11-06))
